title: Word of Mouth, Observed Adoptions, and Anime-Watching Decisions: The Role of the Personal vs. the Community Network
authors: Mina Ameri; Elisabeth Honka; Ying Xie
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. The single regression (regression180423.do) is a linear probability adoption model of y (user adopts anime in week) on continuous lagged word-of-mouth and adoption measures from friends and the community (lagLogNoFriends, LogFriendWOM, LogWOM, LogNoAdoption, average ratings), news flow, finale dummies and interactions, with user x anime, release-week and user x week FE. No binary policy adoption.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe absorb(iaFE weeknumber iwFE). Data: sample5000.dta, 22.4 million user-anime-week rows for 4,994 users (MyAnimeList-type platform data).

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: continuous lagged WOM/adoption regressors; social-influence model, not DiD

data_files_note: 1.8 GB file; readme.txt is a variable dictionary only (no statement on sampling or masking).
data_provenance_note: File name and 4,994 distinct users suggest a 5,000-user sample of the estimation data; README silent.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract (no article text, no PDF). code_prescore 2 from reghdfe with unit and week FE; regressors are continuous peer-effect measures.
